<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the only aliphatic carbon signals are at 43.47 ppm and 38.60 ppm, which are typical for sp³ carbons attached to heteroatoms or part of CH₂ groups, not for methyl (CH₃) carbons that usually appear around 10–30 ppm. All other signals are in the aromatic region. Therefore, the molecule contains no methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
